input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
input.rationale: The only grant clause (para 2) runs to "Customer" alone and is expressly "revocable", with no reference to Affiliates or to contractors acting on our behalf, and no right of sublicense; para 8(a) (p0025) reinforces this by barring any third-party access to the Service absent Kubient's prior written approval. That combination — a licence revocable at Kubient's discretion (independent of the termination machinery in para 4) with affiliates and contractors excluded and only a Kubient-consent path to add them — fails the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice) and sits in walk-away territory. The assignment clause (p0072) does permit assignment of the Agreement to an affiliate or an M&A successor, which satisfies the transferability limb of the fallback, but that does not cure the affiliate/contractor exclusion or the at-will revocation right. Redline extends the grant to our Affiliates and contractors, ties revocation to expiry/termination under para 4, and confirms successor transfer.

proposal.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to Customer's Affiliates and contractors, remove at-will revocability, and confirm transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf and removed the at-will revocation right, so the licence ends only on termination of the Agreement under paragraph 4, together with transfer to a permitted successor. Our playbook requires affiliate/contractor coverage and a licence that is not revocable at Kubient's discretion; if helpful, we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice to Kubient.

ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license, transferable to a successor in accordance with the assignment provisions of this Agreement and revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with paragraph 4, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
